CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERNAMESUFFIX_SEC
AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameSuffix
AS
(
SELECT
BST.CLTCODE AS CustomerId
,HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(BST.FNAME, BST.MNAME,BST.LNAME)) AS CustomerNameId
,BST.SUFF AS NameSuffixId
,'1' AS SuffixOrderNumber
,NULL AS CustomerNameSuffixNote
,BST.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS TaskRunId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,BST.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
,BSTD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT_DELTA BSTD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BST ON BST.CLTCODE = BSTD.CLTCODE AND BST.ISLATEST = '1'
WHERE BST.CLTTYPE = 'I'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameSuffix FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameSuffix;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameSuffix_SRC
AS
(
SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
CustomerId
,CustomerNameId
,NameSuffixId
,SuffixOrderNumber
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, RECORD_STATUS
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameSuffix WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameSuffix_TGT
AS(
SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
CustomerId
,CustomerNameId
,NameSuffixId
,SuffixOrderNumber
)) HASHROW, CustomerId
FROM BNKM.CustomerNameSuffix
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameSuffix_DELTA
AS(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId, TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
,CASE
    WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
    ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameSuffix_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameSuffix_TGT TGT
ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameSuffix_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameSuffix_DELTA;

---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
	[CustomerId] = SRC.CustomerId
	,[CustomerNameId] = SRC.CustomerNameId
	,[NameSuffixId] = SRC.NameSuffixId
	,[SuffixOrderNumber] = SRC.SuffixOrderNumber
	,[CustomerNameSuffixNote] = NULL
	,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,[SourceSystemCode] = 'SEC'
	,[TaskRunId] = 0 
	,[WorkFlowId] = 0 
	,[InsertDttm] = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.CustomerNameSuffix TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameSuffix_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameSuffix SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId ;



--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerNameSuffix
(
CustomerId
,CustomerNameId
,NameSuffixId
,SuffixOrderNumber
,CustomerNameSuffixNote
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT
CustomerId
,CustomerNameId
,NameSuffixId
,SuffixOrderNumber
,NULL AS CustomerNameSuffixNote
,FinancialInstitutionId
,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS TaskRunId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameSuffix
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameSuffix;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNameSuffix_DELTA;

END
